disclaimer: Template descriptions are planning prompts, not implementation or verified proof. Replace sample claims with sourced product details before publishing.

descriptions: State the product’s value and link to an implemented primary action.
Use certifications and customer references only when they are documented and approved.
Add a product demo; connect a working sandbox before presenting it as interactive.
Compare product capabilities using criteria that are specific and supported.
Include measured benchmarks and their methodology, or omit this section.
List current plan names and terms supplied by the product owner.
Answer security, hosting, and export questions from verified product documentation.
Use configured URLs or actions for web and CLI entry points.
Show a verified install command and a first task that works with the current package.
Link to current endpoints, request schemas, and response schemas.
Show a code sample; add an executable sandbox only when one is connected.
Describe the security boundaries and data flows that have been verified.
List only packages and integrations that are currently supported.
Link to active repository or discussion destinations that are maintained.
Show organization-approved measures from the selected data source.
Plot the selected series and state its update cadence only when measured.
Present transaction records and disclose whether data is sample, delayed, or live.
Summarize risk measures with their source, scope, and update time.
Link to reporting formats the product actually provides; describe signing only when verified.
Use licensed imagery with meaningful alt text and reduced-motion support for entrances.
Describe craftsmanship and origin using details supplied by the product owner.
If using a moving image reel, support keyboard, touch, and reduced-motion preferences.
Connect an appointment form or booking service before promising a reservation.
Expose keyboard commands only when the application handles them.
Describe available bulk actions and confirm high-impact changes.
Show fields authorized for the current user and handle sensitive values carefully.
List supported audit events with their access and retention rules.
